entities.name: Implement the independent resolution-result checker
entities.summary: Independently check serialized resolution claims while preserving lossless evidence, policy, canonical binding, and explicit observation limits.

acceptance: The checker preserves exact subjects, candidate sets, evidence results, policy identity, and terminal selection
Checker imports remain independent of resolver execution, realization operations, and I/O
Mutation and symmetry oracles fail for their intended reasons
The unresolved size and trust claim is replaced by an explicit reviewed design before implementation resumes
